say:1:1311213001:0.text: Excuse me, do you work in this castle?
say:1:1311213001:0.source_cn: 这位女士，请问你是这里的侍女吗？

say:2:1311213002:0.text: I've brought the honey muffins that Her Highness loves. Hopefully, they'll cheer her up a little...
say:2:1311213002:0.source_cn: 今天的甜点是公主殿下喜欢的蜂蜜松饼，殿下吃到它，心情或...

say:3:1311213003:0.text: Excuse me, do you know how we can get this door open?
say:3:1311213003:0.source_cn: 女士，你知道该怎么打开这扇大门吗？

say:4:1311213004:0.text: Her Highness hasn't been eating well lately... she's barely touched her food.
say:4:1311213004:0.source_cn: 不过殿下这几天胃口一直不太好……唉，她吃得越来越少了。

say:5:1311213005:0.text: Miss, can you hear us? Hello?
say:5:1311213005:0.source_cn: 呃，女士，你能听到我们讲话吗？

say:6:1311213006:0.text: It's all because of that strange illness; Her Highness can't even go out and enjoy herself anymore. She seems truly upset, trapped in her chamber.
say:6:1311213006:0.source_cn: 都怪那种奇怪的病症，公主殿下都不能外出游玩了，只能待在...

say:7:1311213007:0.text: Her dearest maid, Lydia, has tried to cheer her up multiple times, but nothing seems to work...
say:7:1311213007:0.source_cn: 连殿下最亲近最喜爱的女管家莉娅劝她，她都还是不开心。

say:8:1311213008:0.text: How can someone as lively as her be happy locked away like this? But no one dares go against the Archduke's orders...
say:8:1311213008:0.source_cn: 殿下这样活泼的性子，一直闷在寝殿里怎么会快乐起来呢？可...

say:9:1311213009:0.text: Wait, did she say chamber earlier? Didn't the princess go to the great hall?
say:9:1311213009:0.source_cn: 寝殿？咦，公主不是去了谒见大厅吗？

say:10:1311213010:0.text: It's like she's living in the past, back when Princess Yolena was still alive.
say:10:1311213010:0.source_cn: 在她的意识里，亚莲娜公主还没有死亡，奇怪……她就像是活...

say:11:1311213011:0.text: Hmmm... honey muffins may not be enough. I'll ask the pastry chef to whip up a berry sorbet. Even though the Archduke forbids her from eating cold treats, surely a tiny serving won't hurt...
say:11:1311213011:0.source_cn: 不行，光是蜂蜜松饼还不够，得让甜点师再做一份莓果冰酪。...

choice_prompt:13:1311213011.text: Hmmm... honey muffins may not be enough. I'll ask the pastry chef to whip up a berry sorbet. Even though the Archduke forbids her from eating cold treats, surely a tiny serving won't hurt...
choice_prompt:13:1311213011.source_cn: 不行，光是蜂蜜松饼还不够，得让甜点师再做一份莓果冰酪。殿下一直想吃，虽然大公禁止殿下吃冷食，但小小一份总该可以吧……

say:16:1311213012:0.text: Everything in this castle feels distorted—the floors, the furniture, even the people...
say:16:1311213012:0.source_cn: 这座城堡里的一切都像是被扭曲了，地板、家具、人……给我...

say:17:1311213013:0.text: It's like I've stepped into an abstract painting, nothing feels real.
say:17:1311213013:0.source_cn: 感觉我好像进入了一幅抽象画……

say:18:1311213016:0.text: She can't be a ghost since we can touch her... What's really happening?
say:18:1311213016:0.source_cn: 但她并不是一个幻影，可以被触摸到……这里到底发生了什么？

say:22:1311213017:0.text: I'm hoping today's dessert will bring a smile to Her Highness' face, which might just please the Archduke as well.
say:22:1311213017:0.source_cn: 希望今天的茶点让公主殿下开心一点，这样大公大人也能跟着高兴。

say:23:1311213018:0.text: Please make way, I need to hurry and serve Her Highness tea and dessert.
say:23:1311213018:0.source_cn: 请让让，公主殿下还在寝殿里等着她的茶点，我不能耽误时间。

choice_prompt:24:1311213018.text: Please make way, I need to hurry and serve Her Highness tea and dessert.
choice_prompt:24:1311213018.source_cn: 请让让，公主殿下还在寝殿里等着她的茶点，我不能耽误时间。

say:25:1311213019:0.text: May I ask who you are? Why are you assisting me?
say:25:1311213019:0.source_cn: 请问您是谁？为什么要帮忙送茶点？
say:25:1311213019:0.male: May I ask who you are? Why are you assisting me?
say:25:1311213019:0.female: May I ask who you are? Why are you assisting me?

choice_prompt:26:1311213019.male: May I ask who you are? Why are you assisting me?
choice_prompt:26:1311213019.female: May I ask who you are? Why are you assisting me?

say:28:1311213020:0.text: It seems she can actually hear the magister! Huh? What's going on!?
say:28:1311213020:0.source_cn: 她好像能听到主人说的话……咦？发生了什么？！
say:28:1311213020:0.male: It seems she can actually hear the magister! Huh? What's going on!?
say:28:1311213020:0.female: It seems she can actually hear the magister! Huh? What's going on!?

narration:31:1311213021:0.text: You suddenly feel dizzy as everything around you starts to spin and twist, as if you've been thrown into a kaleidoscope...
narration:31:1311213021:0.source_cn: 你们一阵眩晕，眼前的一切突然开始旋转扭曲，就像是被投入...

choice:24:0:1.text: Let us deliver the dessert for you.
choice:24:0:1.male: Let us deliver the dessert for you.
choice:24:0:1.female: Let us deliver the dessert for you.

say:36:1311213014:0.text: This is so strange! She looks both real and unreal—how could anyone actually look like that?
say:36:1311213014:0.source_cn: 太奇怪了，她看上去又真实又虚假，怎么会有人长成这个样子嘛！

say:37:1311213015:0.text: Everything here feels off, like a mixing of nightmare and reality... Are we really in the real world?
say:37:1311213015:0.source_cn: 这里所有东西都很诡异，就像是噩梦和现实穿插一样……我们...
